function normalizeCountry(name) {
  return name ? name.toString().trim() : "";
}

function getSendAtLocal(tz, targetHour = 09, targetMinute = 30) {
  const now = new Date();

  // Current date in that timezone
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone: tz,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).formatToParts(now);

  const obj = {};
  for (const p of parts) obj[p.type] = p.value;

  const yyyy = obj.year;
  const mm = obj.month;
  const dd = obj.day;

 return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}T09:30:00`;

}

return items.map((item) => {
  const country = normalizeCountry(item.json.Country);

  item.json.timezone = item.json.timezone || countryTimezoneMap[country] || "UTC";
  item.json.Language = item.json.Language || countryLanguageMap[country] || "English";
  item.json.Campaign_ID = item.json.Campaign_ID || "GLOBAL_CAMPAIGN";

  // ✅ 9.30 AM local time (not UTC)
  item.json.send_at = getSendAtLocal(item.json.timezone, 09,30);

  return item;
});
